_comment: JSON has no comment syntax; this key is documentation only and is not read by any client. A generic Streamable HTTP MCP client configuration — the exact key names vary by client (see examples/mcp-clients/README.md for specifics). N8N_OPERATOR_HTTP_BEARER_TOKEN and N8N_OPERATOR_HTTP_ALLOWED_ORIGINS are REQUIRED on the server side for any bind other than loopback (boundary B9) — the server refuses to start without both.
